'''Tarawa''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located in the [[Tarawa system/Legends|Tarawa system]], a part of the [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] prevailed over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at a [[Battle of Tarawa|confrontation]] at Tarawa.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarawa was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tarawa [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square L-19.<ref name="EAOC" /> Tarawa shares its name with the [[Wikipedia:Pacific Ocean|Pacific Ocean]] [[Wikipedia:Atoll|atoll]] [[Wikipedia:Tarawa|Tarawa]], where the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States]] was victorious over the [[Wikipedia:Empire of Japan|Empire of Japan]] in a [[Wikipedia:Battle of Tarawa|battle]] of [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]].<ref name="Britannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/place/Tarawa|text=Tarawa|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2018-01-07|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20230322232524}}</ref>
